signing_policy.registration_rule: PREREGISTERED requires exact canonical payload bytes, a Founder detached signature, a full signing-subkey and primary fingerprint match, target data not public at the knowledge cutoff, source-native derivation, frozen nuisance freedom, analysis code and a predeclared falsifier.
signing_policy.retrospective_rule: Any comparison selected from or constructed after inspecting the target data is RETROSPECTIVE and belongs in the observability inventory, never as a preregistered prediction entry.

next_acceptance: inventory current public numerical claims as RETROSPECTIVE, PREDICTION_CANDIDATE or NOT_YET_OBSERVABLE
select the strongest one to three source-native candidate observables
verify live target dataset and release conditions before adding any PREREGISTERED entry
Founder signs only a non-empty canonical prediction payload that passes the validator
